name: zclass_light_gw_light_update
description: zClass_Light::gwLightUpdate updates active light nodes by rebuilding world-space light state, staging camera-space direction/position caches, and clearing the dirty flag.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this light update helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass light/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x453880 validates null-node/null-data error returns, inactive-node early return, ComputeWorldTransform dispatch, camera-scratch matrix load, point/spot viewDir transform and negation, directional view-position update from worldPosition through the current matrix, dirty flag clear, and zero return.
The native light smoke verifies inactive and null error paths, world transform update, viewDir negation, view-position translation through CameraScratchB, and dirty-flag clear.
